pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, soft cinematic atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
When the road disappears in the dark
no distant stars above the sky
only fading shadows by your side

Hold my hand for a moment
so your steps won't fall again

[Chorus]
I'll be the lantern by your road
a quiet light that never fades
I'll keep the trembling of your heart
steady in the night

I'll stay beside your wandering steps
a gentle glow along the way
even the darkest road ahead
won't take the light away

[Verse 2]
When the cold wind brushes your face
and the end of the road can't be seen
even the smallest hope hides away

Listen closely to my voice
I'm still standing next to you

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, flowing melody)

[Bridge]
Sometimes the night grows deeper
and the silence feels too wide
but a single light in darkness
can still guide the road ahead

[Chorus]
I'll be the lantern by your road
a quiet light that never fades
I'll keep the trembling of your heart
steady in the night

I'll stay beside your wandering steps
a gentle glow along the way
even the darkest road ahead
won't take the light away

[Outro]
(piano instrumental outro, calm fading atmosphere)
